newsitem.title: USA: Dean Foods acquires ice cream distributor.
newsitem.headline: Dean Foods acquires ice cream distributor.

text.p: Dean Foods Co said Monday it acquired Meadows Distributing Co, the largest distributor of ice cream, novelties and frozen desserts in the Chicago metropolitan area with nearly $70 million in annual sales. Terms were not announced.

"Meadows has an outstanding reputation in distribution and customer service, serving the largest supermarkets, as well as a significant share of the independent grocery trade, in its market area," Howard Dean, chairman, said in a statement. "We anticipate continued growth both in Meadows' existing market and in new markets."
Robert Neville, Meadows chairman, said his company has had a close relationship with Dean Foods for many years, during which time the two firms recognized their complementary strengths.

"Dean's superior capabilities in ice cream manufacturing, sales and marketing combined with our strengths in distribution, merchandising and customer service will allow us to continue to exceed the needs of our customers," Neville said.

Dean Foods had been expected to announce an acquisition in the current fiscal fourth quarter. In an interview last week, William McManaman, chief financial officer, said the company was looking at several potential candidates.

Dean Foods is the nation's leading dairy processor and distributor with a fully line of branded and private label products including fluid milk, cottage cheese and ice cream. It also has vegetable, pickle and specialty foods businesses.
